snippet.title: Something Meaningful | Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist Something Meaningful on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4006300/Something_Meaningful/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=game_promotion&utm_content=trailer

Something Meaningful is an open-world RPG where you decide how to live after your death. Work, study, train, explore the city, customize your appearance, meet cartoonish characters and unlock interesting locations as you try to do something meaningful with this new opportunity.
